newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco praises Israel-PLO accord on Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Morocco praises Israel-PLO accord on Hebron.

text.p: Morocco's King Hassan told Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday he hoped the Hebron agreement would lead to a just and durable peace in the Middle East.
An Israeli official said it was the first direct contact the king had made with Netanyahu since he became prime minister last June.

King Hassan told Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in a separate message he hoped the accord would open the way for Palestinians to take the "remaining steps leading to the realisation of the aspirations for which they have fought."

The messages, carried by the official Moroccan news agency MAP, followed Israel and Palestinian agreement on Wednesday to launch long-delayed Palestinian self-rule in Hebron and on Israeli withdrawals in the West Bank.
The Moroccan monarch told Netanyahu, who came to power on a programme against ceding land to Arabs, he hoped honouring the long-delayed accord to withdraw from Hebron would lead to further progress.
"We rejoice in advance of the entente that this accord is going to promote and we hope that the future, cleared of the past, finally opens on a serious outlook for a just and durable peace." he said.
King Hassan worked for years behind the scenes to promote peace between Arabs and Israelis was a friend of former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres, who was ousted by Netanyahu.
